caseName: Galveston, Houston & Henderson Railroad v. United States
caseNameFull: Galveston, Houston & Henderson Railroad Company v. United States

opinions.text: October 25, 1920. Petition for a writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit denied. Mr. Alex. Britton, Mir. Evans Browne and Mr. J. W. Terry for petitioner. The Solicitor General and Mrs. Annette Abbott Adams, Assistant Attorney General, for the United States.
